title: Add servo support
ask: Add servo support to transpiler and code generation
did: Adds the requested helper and transpiles its calls to Arduino C++.
note: Keep the tested implementation. Add a test or a reason for each unchecked block, or it stays out. Hardware behaviour needs a human check.

lines: ``min_pulse_us`` and ``max_pulse_us`` microseconds to cover the angular range
from ``min_angle`` to ``max_angle`` degrees.  The defaults match the Arduino
Servo library (approximately 0-180 degrees mapped to 544-2400 microseconds).
risk.note: Host-side tests pass. Check angle and pulse limits against the physical servo specification.
risk.check: Fixed head regression suite; physical Arduino not checked.
